beneficiaryAdministration: The EUCF is open to all municipalities/local authorities (or their groupings) from the 27 EU Member States, Iceland, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia and Ukraine. The EUCF submission process: i) Eligibility check; ii) Full application. 4 evaluation criteria: 1. Ambition of the proposed investment concept; 2. Governance structure for the development of the investment concept; 3. Stakeholders engagement strategy; 4. Coherence and plausibility
description: The investment concepts will represent an initial step towards fully-fledged business and financial plans and facilitate the subsequent mobilization of investments in energy efficiency and renewable energy. Maximum grant amount per investment concept (lump-sum) is 60.000 EUR.
